scope: One fixed-budget warm-start of the existing routed student. Public numerical evidence only.

selected_visual_review.review_type: Unblinded developer inspection of fixed-conversion previews and native-size center crops; not final acceptance.
findings: Water and droplet examples retain the broad appearance; differences in brightness and fine texture remain.
The Sponza textile/stone crops still differ from the native teacher in fine pattern detail and shading.
The city-light example still differs in highlights, color and local detail.
The selected faces-bucket source is an antique portrait whose center crop omits the head; it does not establish face fidelity. Bucket names are retrieval categories, not certified coverage.

posthoc_regression_review.label: teacher-photo-landscape
posthoc_regression_review.finding: Visible color/tone and fine-detail differences remain; the new student shifts bright mountain/cloud colors further from this native target.
posthoc_regression_review.selection: Largest development MAE increase, chosen after scoring. Not an independent acceptance test.

optimization.loss: L1 + 0.25 * horizontal and vertical gradient L1

training.scope: Same inference architecture and existing candidate warm start. Exact host FP16 input/target cache; FP32 model fitting. No final-test data, architecture change, new kernels or installation.

evaluation.timing_scope: Complete FP16 model at 1920x1080, both stages including final grade. Existing fusions unchanged; no inference feature cache.
limitations: Development comparisons only; no independent final gameplay or temporal validation.
Additional warm-start training is not an equal-training-compute architecture comparison.
Standalone CUDA graph excludes application conversion, synchronization and composition.
p95 is over ten-replay interval averages, not individual-frame tails.
Pixel error does not establish perceptual equivalence. No model has been installed.
Still-image development data, not independent gameplay acceptance trials.
The new sources are partitioned by author; this is not proof of universal source independence.
The candidate received additional training; this is not a compute-matched architecture comparison.
Standalone model latency excludes application conversion, synchronization and composition.
Interval p95 is not individual frame-tail latency.
Private teacher pixels and learned checkpoint/export payloads are not distributed.
